newsitems.title: Spiked Beasts Rampage Through the Clockworks
newsitems.author: Grey Havens, LLC
newsitems.contents: A Beastly Spike Storm Strikes the Clockworks! As the first frost settles over Cradle, a shimmering storm is sweeping through the Beast levels of the Clockworks, scattering mysterious energy spikes across the frozen ground like glittering icicles. Hungry and restless as winter closes in, the local beasts can't resist their pull! Reach the spikes before the beasts get their paws on them, or face tou...

newsitems.title: A Fowl Dark Harvest Festival!
newsitems.author: Spiral HQ
newsitems.contents: The Punkin King is back to cause sweet chaos, and the knight owls over at Spiral HQ have returned with their goods! Read on for everything coming to the Clockworks this season with the Dark Harvest Festival and the return of the Owlite Archaeology Prize Box.The Dark Harvest Festival makes its return! It's no trick: the Punkin King and his gourdlings are causing sweet, sweet chaos in the Clockworks...

newsitems.title: Tortodrones' Autumn March
newsitems.author: Spiral HQ
newsitems.contents: Autumn has settled over the Clockworks, Knights, and that means the Tortodrones are on the move once again! Spiral HQ is calling on you to protect them on their Long Migration. The fiendish denizens of the Clockworks have found the migration irresistible and are collecting tortodrone parts for mysterious purposes.
